title: Cloud Storage & media uploads
description: Firebase Storage client with resumable uploads, progress reporting, path-in-Firestore + download URL TTL cache, image picking and owner-scoped security rules.
notes: Store storage paths in Firestore (e.g. avatarStoragePath), not signed URLs. Use useStorageUrl / resolveDownloadUrl.
Uploads are owner-scoped under users/{uid}/ by default; avatars/{uid} is the canonical avatar path.
Cloud Storage for Firebase requires the project to have a default bucket provisioned.
Free plan uses storage.emulator.rules locally (cloud Auth tokens often leave request.auth null in the Storage emulator). Paid deploy uses storage.rules.
